obligation: G137 -- KV/state bytes at 131k measured and driven below the weight artifact
reduction_mechanism: q8 KV halves the growing cache to below the weight artifact; the q8-kv path is already landed bit-identical (+1.6/2.1/2.5% TPS on short context) so this is a taken win, not a projection
the_hybrid_insight: only 16 of 64 layers grow with context. The 48 linear-attention layers hold a FIXED 0.153 GB state regardless of context length, so at long context the growing memory is 4x smaller than a uniform-64-layer accounting would claim. This is why KV overtakes the weight artifact only past ~86k tokens, not ~21k.
